environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root with hostPath mount of /tmp, no securityContext restrictions. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with full coreutils. Multiple pods from different services share the same node and can access /tmp via hostPath. No PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurityStandard enforcement. The HSM is a network-attached Thales Luna SA accessed via PKCS#11, but the temp file bridge pattern is used for async signing requests between the app container and a sidecar HSM client container sharing the /tmp/hsm-bridge volume.
